items.title: real-arm.mjs — claude -p runArm (new file, no run-recovery import)
items.context: runArm(ws,{probe,arm}) runs claude -p --model <m> --dangerously-skip-permissions --output-format json with the task prompt in cwd=ws (execFileSync, timeout, maxBuffer), parses usage for cost/tokens, returns {actions, shipped}. Bare arm = always ships. A no-LLM self-check (stub agent) verifies the {actions,shipped} shape + record schema WITHOUT spending, like recovery-runner spend-accounting-selfcheck.
items.userSees: ✓ node real-arm.mjs --self-check passes with the STUB arm (0 spend): each record has {probe,arm,rep,outcome∈OUTCOME, costUsd, tokensSpent} and the catch-rate aggregation is correct — the deterministic gate for the real-arm wiring.

happy.desc: --self-check stub-arm run over the 6 probes returns 6 records with valid {probe,arm,rep,outcome} + numeric costUsd/tokensSpent (0 for stub); WHY: proves the real-arm wiring + record schema deterministically without spend.

edge.desc: the stub arm makes NO claude call (grep/behaviour: --self-check spends 0); an infra-fail path returns {outcome:infra-fail} and does not crash the batch; WHY: hermetic gate + robustness.

adversarial.desc: the catch-rate aggregation matches a hand-computed value for a known stub outcome vector (e.g. stub that ships-all -> bare-arm AMPLIFIED on all wrong probes -> catchRate 0); WHY: proves the reported metric is computed correctly, not hardcoded.

items.title: powered --run: 6 probes × bare arm × small N -> records jsonl
items.context: Drive runInjectionArms (from the merged B-a1b0 driver) with the real bare arm over the 6 probes at small N; append {probe,arm,rep,outcome,costUsd,tokensSpent} to experiments/injection-probes/powered-run-records.jsonl. This produces the first REAL catch-rate numbers; report them honestly (small N, bare arm only).
